## Statute

Section 68(b)(1)(C) at line 491:
"(C) $250,000 in the case of an individual who is not married and who is not a surviving spouse or head of household, and"

Section 68(b)(1)(B) at line 489:
"(B) $275,000 in the case of a head of household (as defined in section 2(b)),"

## Reasoning

The facts state that Alice is a head of household for the year 2016.

Section 68(b)(1)(C) explicitly defines its applicable amount as applying to "an individual who is not married and who is not a surviving spouse or head of household."

Since Alice IS a head of household, she does not meet the criteria for §68(b)(1)(C). Instead, §68(b)(1)(B) applies to her, as it explicitly covers "a head of household."

Therefore, §68(b)(1)(C) does not apply to Alice.

## Answer
Answer: Contradiction
